name: Scary Game
storyline:
You wake up in a pitch-black, unfamiliar corridor — and your only "weapon" is your curiosity.
In this absurd, dark comedy walking simulator, each door leads you to a strange and unpredictable room. Sometimes it’ll test your nerves, sometimes it’ll trigger your laughter.
You’ll be scared, you’ll laugh... but more than anything, you’ll ask yourself: “How do I get out of here?”

Scary Game offers a short yet unforgettable experience, lasting around 15–25 minutes.
Will you escape, or will you remain the main character of this twisted comedy?
summary: You open your eyes in a dark, unfamiliar room; each door drags you into a new chamber filled with absurd surprises and dark comedy. Will you manage to escape, or will you continue to star in this black comedy?
